articles.title: Quantum-proof blockchain: why math, not machines, holds the key
articles.snippet: Blockchains don’t need quantum computers to be quantum-safe, argues Optimum co-founder and MIT professor Muriel Médard. Classic math already gives us the tools.

articles.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.
